newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish bond prices undulate ahead of U.S. data.
newsitem.headline: Danish bond prices undulate ahead of U.S. data.

text.p: Danish bond prices see-sawed on Thursday morning as investors awaited key U.S. producer price data due out later in the day.
"We expect it to be a fairly cautious day until publication of the American data, but sentiment is positive," a dealer said.

The benchmark eight percent state bond due 2006 opened at 104.95, up 0.15 point from Wednesday's close, fell to 104.86 and by 0750 GMT had inched back up to 104.90. The 10-year yield gap with Germany narrowed to 96 basis points from Wednesday's 97 bp. The crown firmed to 3.8549 per mark from 3.8560 on Wednesday. --Eva Elgaard Pedersen, Copenhagen newsroom, 45-33-969650
